cards.speaker: src_weather
cards.text: The gauge reads nothing. A grain barge settles onto the sill with a sound like a door closing. The chamber is a stone room with a boat in it.

text_variants.text: The gauge reads nothing. Quenn stands beside you with her folio shut. "The figures said this," she says. "Sorry. They said this."

left.label: Write the true figures
left.outcome: The last entry in your hand.

right.label: Write 'drought'
right.outcome: The Company will read it, and agree.

cards.speaker: src_weather
cards.text: At the third bell the east embankment goes. The sound is not loud. Then the town's lamps go out one street at a time, from the bottom up.

text_variants.text: At the third bell the east embankment goes. Nobody sandbagged; nobody would come when you called. The town's lamps go out from the bottom up.

left.label: Run for the paddles
left.outcome: Too late, and you know it.

right.label: Run for the town
right.outcome: You carry a child up Chapel Street. It is one.

cards.speaker: pell
cards.text: Keeper. Forty-one vessels between here and Lock 6. Aldmere has closed its flight. The Board has wired. I did not read it aloud. I am reading it to you now.

left.label: Ask what it says
left.outcome: "'Remove.' One word. They used to write more."

cards.speaker: dace
cards.text: Two in the chamber, Keeper, both at speed, because nobody was counting any more. The coal boat's under the grain boat. Stroud is down there. Three things: you'll want to come, you'll want to not, and it doesn't matter.

right.label: Send for the Company
right.outcome: Dace looks at you the way he looks at a broken paddle.

cards.speaker: kell
cards.text: The Board regrets. Wages unpaid for three watches constitute abandonment of the works. The account is closed and the appointment with it. Arrangements have been made for your furniture.

left.label: Ask who bought it
left.outcome: "Mrs Cole, at a fair price. Regrettably."

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: The account shows a surplus the toll table cannot produce. For the record, I asked you twice. There is one explanation in the manual. The constables know it too.

text_variants.text: The account shows a surplus the toll table cannot produce. I asked you twice, and I wanted you to have an answer. You will find I have written the kindest version that is still true.

left.label: It was for the gates
left.outcome: "Noted. It is not what the manual calls it."

cards.speaker: src_telegram
cards.text: COMPANY TO KEEPER HALFWAY STOP APPOINTMENT REVOKED STOP VACATE BY NEXT WATCH STOP HAND BOOK AND KEYS TO AUDITOR STOP

left.label: Hand over the Book
left.outcome: Vosk takes it without opening it.

right.label: Tear out your pages first
right.outcome: The Ledger is not the Book. You keep the Ledger.

cards.speaker: kell
cards.text: The Board's view is that you are the Meridian Canal. Your likeness will go on the Jubilee medal and your name on every statement about the water. You need only say yes.

text_variants.text: The Board's view is that you are the Meridian Canal. You have read the file, so you understand exactly what the medal is for. You need only say yes.

left.label: Yes
left.outcome: The medal is bronze. The crowd, later, will know the face.

right.label: Ask for time
right.outcome: "The Board's view is that there is none."

cards.speaker: ilse
cards.text: Nobody is shouting. The doors are barred, the tow ropes are cut, and the town is walking you to the boundary stone with lamps. I am carrying one. I am sorry about that.

left.label: Walk with them
left.outcome: At the stone she says, "It costs what it costs."

cards.speaker: solas
cards.text: The town has risen for you and against the charter. I have orders to take you east. I have also told my people not to load. Come quietly and nobody here learns what a rifle sounds like.

left.label: Go quietly
left.outcome: The town watches. Nobody fires. He was right about that.

right.label: Ask the town to stand down
right.outcome: They do, for you. Then you go east anyway.
